const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""RoboPaint eai-standard/2.2 episode driver and trajectory record."""
+import sys
+import time
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+R = Robot()
+DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
+
+
+def pose_now():
+    return np.asarray(R.get_obs(cameras=[], video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+
+
+def send_rows(rows, dt, note):
+    rows = np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32)
+    # The client accepts at most 400 rows and 10 s per call.
+    n = min(400, max(1, int(9.5 / dt)))
+    results = []
+    for i in range(0, len(rows), n):
+        res = R.submit("ee_pose", rows[i:i+n], dt=dt, video="none", note=note)
+        results.append(res)
+        if res.meta.get("plan"):
+            failures = [p for p in res.meta["plan"] if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("ik_ok") is False]
+            if failures:
+                print("IK plan failures", failures[:3])
+    return results
+
+
+def travel_to(x, y, z, dt=0.20, max_step=0.035, note="travel"):
+    a = pose_now()
+    b = np.r_[x, y, z, DOWN]
+    distance = float(np.linalg.norm(b[:3] - a[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(distance / max_step)))
+    rows = np.array([a + (b-a) * (i/n) for i in range(1, n+1)])
+    send_rows(rows, dt, note)
+
+
+def press_move(x0, y0, x1, y1, z, speed=0.035, note="practice stroke"):
+    a = np.r_[x0, y0, z, DOWN]
+    b = np.r_[x1, y1, z, DOWN]
+    length = float(np.linalg.norm(b[:2] - a[:2]))
+    # 2 mm path samples keep the 20 Hz interpolator's contact path smooth.
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(length / 0.002)))
+    rows = np.array([a + (b-a) * (i/n) for i in range(1, n+1)])
+    dt = 0.05
+    # At the chosen spacing, a speed <= 40 mm/s is within the controller limit.
+    send_rows(rows, dt, note)
+
+
+def stage_calibration():
+    print("initial status", R.status())
+    print("start tip", pose_now())
+    # The ink stone center is obtained from the side-camera RGB-D map.
+    travel_to(-0.100, 0.131, 0.105, note="approach ink stone")
+    travel_to(-0.100, 0.131, 0.014, dt=0.15, max_step=0.010, note="dip brush")
+    # Keep the tip in the ink briefly so the hairs gather and load.
+    send_rows([np.r_[-0.100, 0.131, 0.014, DOWN]] * 8, 0.10, "load brush")
+    travel_to(-0.100, 0.131, 0.105, dt=0.15, max_step=0.010, note="lift from ink")
+    # Practice sheet center is at world x=-0.100, y=-0.1856; top is z=0.020.
+    travel_to(-0.100, -0.205, 0.105, note="approach practice sheet")
+    travel_to(-0.100, -0.205, 0.012, dt=0.15, max_step=0.010, note="press on practice sheet")
+    press_move(-0.100, -0.205, -0.100, -0.160, 0.012, note="practice width calibration")
+    travel_to(-0.100, -0.160, 0.105, dt=0.15, max_step=0.010, note="lift from practice sheet")
+    print("calibration status", R.status())
+    o = R.get_obs(cameras=["practice_cam", "side_cam", "scene_cam", "canvas_cam"], video="none")
+    from PIL import Image
+    for cam, img in o.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(img).save("/app/output/calibration_" + cam + ".png")
+    return o
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    stage_calibration()
*** End Patch";
